learnings.title: HO-05 Shopify GraphQL alan listesi kapısı
learnings.claim: ChatGPT proposed process gate HO-05_SHOPIFY_GRAPHQL_FIELDS on 2026-10-10 (branch chatgpt/domain-promotions-20261010). It is a review/verification procedure, not verified research; no field, metric or claim in it has been checked against the cited source yet.
learnings.decision: HO-05_SHOPIFY_GRAPHQL_FIELDS: Request products{id,title,status,variants{price,inventoryItem{unitCost}},metafields}, orders{id,createdAt,totalPriceSet,lineItems{product,variant,quantity,discountedTotalSet},customer{id,numberOfOrders},refunds,fulfillments}, customers{id,ordersCount}, analytics cohort fields only if API access/scopes verified; avoid claiming Shopify Admin GraphQL supports every proposed field without schema introspection.
learnings.next_measurement: Record the first real application of this gate (inputs, source URL fetched, result) and upgrade evidence_status only after that read-back.
